paragraphs: An E. coli outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts has grown to 76 cases across 16 states, with 6 hospitalizations [2]. A separate E. coli O26 outbreak linked to raw milk cheese has sickened 13 people across 9 states, with 8 hospitalizations [1]. The Salmonella outbreak traced to jalapeños has ended after affecting 488 people across 34 states [3].

Sempio Food Services Inc. recalled Korean Ginseng Chicken Stew Classic products sold in Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, and Virginia due to import violations [4]. Fontanini Foods LLC recalled Pork Sausage Links packed on 06/23/2026 distributed to California, Florida, Michigan, and Nevada due to possible foreign matter contamination [5]. Sierra Nevada Cheese Company recalled all Graziers Raw Milk Cheese currently in the market due to potential E. coli O26:H11 contamination [12].

Additional recalls include frozen organic berry products from Frutas y Hortalizas del Sur S.A., including Great Value Triple Berry Blend and Blueberries, and Trader Joe's Frozen Organic Mixed Berry Blend due to potential E. coli O145 contamination [7]. WinCo Foods recalled Salsa Bean Dip Trays containing recalled peperoncini [8]. EAK Distribution recalled HOME GROWN Green Sprouting Calabrese Broccoli Seeds due to possible Salmonella contamination [6]. G.L. Mezzetta recalled Golden Greek Peperoncini Medium Heat due to pest contamination [13].
